Scene:
比方说，他一次试一试有些植物的叶，吃得又新鲜又甜。煮这些叶以后，他一喝就知道他发现新的茶叶。虽然他找到了很多的新的植物，但是他的旅程有的时候特别是危险。比方说，他一吃灵芝就开始生病。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 他一次试一试有些植物的叶，吃得又新鲜又甜：有一次；试了试，了completed; 叶子；吃起来
- 煮这些叶以后，他一喝就知道他发现新的茶叶：煮了，了completed; 叶子
- 虽然他找到了很多的新的植物：很多新的植物
- 但是他的旅程有的时候特别是危险：特别危险，”特别是+N, + Clause” is used to single out a typical example
- 他一吃灵芝就开始生病：wrong information, 灵芝is a medicine

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 知道他发现了新的茶叶：知道发现了新的茶叶，The second pronoun refers to the same character within the same sentence, so Chinese naturally uses zero form rather than repeating the pronoun. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
Run 2: Coherence (Reference): 他发现：发现，The subject is already “他” earlier in the same sentence, so use zero form rather than repeating the pronoun. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
Run 3: Coherence (Reference): 知道他发现了新的茶叶：知道发现了新的茶叶，After the same person has already been named in this sentence, omit the repeated pronoun when the referent remains clear. [rule: ambiguous_reference]

output.reason: All runs remove the repeated subject pronoun 他 in the same clause, yielding the same natural zero-subject correction.
